body:
# Sharkion
After getting caught in a terrible storm while out at sea as a young child a shiver of sharks find you and take you to their cave they raise you as a shark and you eventually mutate into a shark human hybrid a sharkion.

## Abilities

### Shark lunge 
Propell yourself forward while in the water while swimming.
### Shark Stomach
You are able to store items in your stomach.

## Buffs

### Ocean Predator
You deal more damage underwater and better vision.

## Passives

### Shark gills 
You can regain airbubbles by swimming.
### Shark bite
Your attacks make people bleed (visual only)
### Stunted growth 
Being raised by sharks your growth has been stunted leaving you shorter than average.

## Nerfs

### Pyrophobia
Fire burns your water adapted skin more than normal.
### Piscivore
You can only eat fish, either cooked or raw.
### Sluggish legs
Since you spent most your life in the water you have gotten sluggish while on land making you slower.
### Uneasy heat
The neather the heat is too much for you causing you to shake uncontrollably and causes you vision to blur also weakening you.
